newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp falls, hurt by earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Sharp falls, hurt by earnings forecast.

text.p: Shares in Sharp Corp dropped in Friday moring trade, depressed by an earnings forcast which was not was good as expected, brokers said.
As of 0137 GMT, the shares were down 60 yen at 1,720 yen, ranking 12th on the top trade by volume list with a 1.133 million share trade.

On Thursday, Sharp said its sales for the year to March 31 1997 were estimated at 1.36 trillion yen against 1.28 trillion in the previous year. It said parent current profit was due to hit 74.00 billion yen against 70.53 billion in the year before.
